name: Bayer CropScience Ltd
about: Bayer CropScience is engaged in Agri Care business which primarily includes manufacture, sale and distribution of insecticides, fungicides, herbicide and various other agrochemical products and corn seeds.[1]
keyPoints: History[1] The Bayer group launched its Indian operations in 1958 by setting up an agrochemical manufacturing unit, in which the group has 68.58% stake. Company manufactures and markets crop protection solutions, and trades in seeds on behalf of Bayer Bioscience Pvt Ltd.
pros: Stock is providing a good dividend yield of 4.39%.
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 93.8%
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 74.0 days to 56.1 days
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 5.90% over past five years.
